field_edits.updated_text: Extensor carpi ulnaris (ECU) tendon sheath shows circumferential distension with fusiform fluid/synovial thickening, consistent with tenosynovitis. The extensor tendons are normal in course and signal intensity without evidence of tenosynovitis.
Mild joint effusion is noted. No subluxation is identified. The radiocarpal and intercarpal articulations are maintained.

Postoperative changes are present involving the distal radius. Patchy STIR hyperintense marrow signal is seen in the triquetrum and trapezium, likely reactive edema/contusion. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion. The marrow signal is otherwise normal.
Mild subcutaneous soft-tissue edema is present. Susceptibility/distortion artefacts from postoperative changes limit evaluation of adjacent osseous and soft-tissue structures.

impression:
1. Postoperative changes of the distal radius with susceptibility artefacts limiting evaluation of adjacent structures.
2. Extensor carpi ulnaris (ECU) tendon sheath tenosynovitis.
3. Patchy marrow edema-like signal in the triquetrum and trapezium, likely reactive/contusional.
4. Mild wrist joint effusion.
5. Mild subcutaneous soft-tissue edema.
6. Degenerative osteoarthritic changes of the left wrist.
